raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "2.5"

package:
  name: qrdet
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/q/qrdet/qrdet-${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ed1742dac3f4abb50a5b75490776e7fa35dcb098d9b6be8a3dc08351e9bfdc80

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install .
  noarch: python

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
    - pip
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - ultralytics
    - ultralytics-thop
    - torchvision =0.22 # match torch compatibility table at https://github.com/pytorch/vision#installation
    - quadrilateral-fitter
    - numpy
    - requests
    - tqdm

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - qrdet
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/Eric-Canas/qrdet
  summary: Robust QR Detector based on YOLOv8
  license_file: LICENSE
  license: MIT

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - carlodri
